title: 第一百四十八章 犹如臭虫前往执行第一百四十七章 着手调查皇帝任务
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 贾环开始查阅皇帝给他的这一些资料。
此人基本上已经退居在后面了，再也没有出现过了，特别是这几年连一点消息都没有。
他在自己的王府之中当是第七皇子。
也是有着七贤王的美誉。
因为当年他是喜欢做好事的，但是现在时过境迁，都已经过去这么多年了，一切情况也都不一样了。
现在这一些完全不同，所以他的消息也是消失的无影无踪，没有任何一个人知道他到底怎么了。
贾环他们现在需要负责的就是这一块的事情，需要去到那里去调查这一个人的情况。
问题是眼前老鬼还没有彻底的解决掉，所以面对这样的一个情况其实还是有一点麻烦的，就是需要想尽一切办法先把老鬼给解决掉。
“这个老家伙就如同一条臭虫一样躲藏在坑之中，完全无法把它给挖出来，确实是让人有些难受。”
不过这也是没有办法的事情，毕竟人家也不是那种随意让人拿捏的这么厉害的一个人物，肯定不会让你轻易的去解决的。
贾环这一边已经做足了准备，加上现在这样的一个情况对于他们来说还是比较的重要的，只要接下来这一点能够负责的好，那么其他的一些情况应该就不会有太大的一个问题存在了。
他们也是在思考现在有可能会出现的一些事情，只要接下去这样的一些状况能够解决的话，那基本上其他的一些事情就能够容易很多了。
“老大放心好了，这一边我们一定会格外的注意的，在接下来的这一个情况之中，我们定然能够彻底的去做好。”
“要不然在接下来的这一个状况里面，若是连这一些都没有办法彻底的处理好，那么情况肯定是更加的麻烦和复杂了。”
其实他们对于自己现在内心深处是比较清楚的，也都知道现如今这样的一些情况该如何去处理，如果连这一些都没有办法彻底的解决，那么问题是比较麻烦的。
因为都会有隐藏的一个人在那里等待着他们，不过有了之前的这一些准备，那么处理这一些事情的时候也就能够方便很多了。
再加上对于他们来说这样的一些事情也是非常的重要的，此刻所做的这一些事情还是能够彻底的去解决出来的，要不然的话，他们现在这样的一个状况可就不容易了。
“很好，那我们就接着去查他的一些情况，然后在这一边我们自己要做出的准备，只有这里一切准备好了，那么其他的状况才能够变得容易起来。”
贾环他们现在确实是非常在意这一个情况，既然皇帝安排他去做另外的一件事情，那他也要想着把另外的事情给做好了，不能够辜负了皇帝。
主要是现在自己的实力并不足够，若是自己的实力到达一定的程度，那根本就不会去理会皇帝到底在干什么事情。
就是因为现在的实力还不够，还需要皇帝给他们提供一定的保障。
“头，我们查了那一边他虽然一直都没有出现，但是据说他身边高手如云，不是一般的人能够接近得了他的据说以前也有人想要刺杀他，但是每一个接近他的人全部都自己死了。”
这一个情况可就是完全不一样了。
可以看得出来眼前这一个家伙确实是非常的不简单，完全让人预料不到。
他们此刻还是需要把这一个家伙周围的倾斜情况给调查清楚，知道这一些事情也清楚，在接下来的情况之中可能不会那么容易了。
“没有想到这一个人还挺复杂的，看来跟我们之前所想的可是完全不一样的，我们以为他能够轻松的应付，但这只是我们自己以为而已。”
贾环能够感受得到这一边的情况确实是让他们料想不到，而且这一边的情况完全是非常复杂的。
皇帝想要解决掉的这一个人，他身边就有高手很多。
而且他人称七贤王，本来名声就不会差，但是在皇帝调查的这一边的情况，他可是站在太上皇那里的，很有可能以前太上皇就是他掉的包，或者是他参与以及他也有加入的。
皇帝这才想要把这一个家伙彻底的挖出来，即便是自己的叔叔，但是做了这样的事情，那也是不可饶恕的。
所以才会出现现在这样的一个情况。
“头，就算他们高手再多，那又怎样？我们这边又不是没有高手，我们也有高手能够与他们进行对抗。”
如今这一个情况也是如此，这一边也不是完全没有能力去应付的。
贾环听到这一些点了点头，毕竟自己的身手就不错，自己也能够应付一部分的人，再加上那一边可能也有一些人自己也能够好好的去对付。
“我清楚这一点，相信在接下来的这一个情况里边，我们必然能够彻底的拿捏住他。”
“大家并不需要太过于担心，做好我们眼前的这一些事情，他基本上就不会有太大的一个问题了。”
现在他们还是有这样的一个准备，既然有了这样一个准备，那么做一些别的事情也就能够容易很多。
只有他们这里先做好了，那么事情就容易很多了，所以组织好自己的人之后就立即赶过去了。
绝对没有任何犹豫可言的，对于这样的一些家伙，那就应该尽快的去解决掉他。
贾环对于任何人都不会心慈手软，即便这一个人的名声再好，因为在他看来这个世道都已经乱成这样了，名声再好的又如何？估计也好不到哪里去。
所以面对这样的一个家伙，那就应该尽快的解决掉，绝对不应该留着留着也是浪费。
所以在接到皇帝的这一个任务之后，很快就已经开始组织起自己这一边的人物，完全没有把这一些家伙给放在眼里。
毕竟要尽快的去解决，那么才能够处理好这一些事情，要是在这里待的时间过长，那么浪费的可就是其他的一些时间没有多大的用处。
贾环和叶天士带着心腹立即出发，前往地方执行任务。
content_en:
Jia Huan began to check the information given to him by the emperor.
This person has basically retreated to the background and never appeared again, especially in the past few years, there has been no news at all.
He is the seventh prince in his own palace.
He is also known as the Seven Wise Kings.
Because he liked to do good deeds back then, but now times have changed, so many years have passed, and everything is different.
Now these are completely different, so his news has disappeared without a trace, and no one knows what happened to him.
Jia Huan and the others need to be responsible for this matter now, and they need to go there to investigate this person's situation.
The problem is that the old ghost in front of us has not been completely solved yet, so facing such a situation is actually a bit troublesome, that is, we need to do everything we can to get rid of the old ghost first.
"This old guy is hiding in a hole like a bug, and it's completely impossible to dig him out. It's really uncomfortable."
But there is no way around this. After all, he is not the kind of person who can be manipulated casually. He will definitely not let you solve it easily.
Jia Huan's side has already made sufficient preparations, and the current situation is still relatively important to them. As long as they can take responsibility for this next point, then other situations should not be a big problem.
They are also thinking about some things that may happen now. As long as these situations can be solved, other things will basically become much easier.
"Don't worry, boss. We will pay special attention to this. In the next situation, we will definitely be able to do it thoroughly."
"Otherwise, in the next situation, if there is no way to deal with these thoroughly, then the situation will definitely be more troublesome and complicated."
In fact, they are relatively clear about what is deep in their hearts, and they all know how to deal with some situations like this today. If there is no way to completely solve these problems, then the problem will be more troublesome.
Because there will always be a hidden person waiting for them there, but with these previous preparations, it will be much easier to deal with these things.
In addition, such things are also very important to them. The things they are doing at this moment can still be solved thoroughly. Otherwise, their current situation will not be easy.
"Very good, then we will continue to check some of his situation, and then we have to make preparations here. Only when everything is ready here, can other situations become easier."
Jia Huan and the others are indeed very concerned about this situation now. Since the emperor has arranged for him to do another thing, he must also think about doing the other thing well and not let the emperor down.
The main reason is that my current strength is not enough. If my strength reaches a certain level, I will not care about what the emperor is doing.
It's because their current strength is not enough, and they still need the emperor to provide them with certain guarantees.
"Head, we checked that side and although he has never appeared, it is said that there are many masters around him. Not ordinary people can get close to him. It is said that there were people who wanted to assassinate him before, but everyone who came close to him died."
This situation is completely different.
It can be seen that the guy in front of him is indeed very extraordinary and completely unexpected.
They still need to investigate the tilt situation around this guy at this moment. Knowing these things, they also know that it may not be so easy in the next situation.
"I didn't expect this person to be quite complicated. It seems to be completely different from what we thought before. We thought he could handle it easily, but that's just what we thought."
Jia Huan could feel that the situation on this side was indeed unexpected, and the situation on this side was completely complicated.
The person the emperor wanted to get rid of had many masters around him.
Moreover, he is called the Seven Wise Kings, and his reputation is not bad in the first place, but in the case of the emperor's investigation, he is on the side of the Supreme Emperor. It is very likely that the Supreme Emperor was the one who was tricked by him before, or he participated or joined.
The emperor now wanted to dig out this guy completely. Even if he was his uncle, it was unforgivable to do such a thing.
That's why a situation like this appears now.
"Head, no matter how many experts they have, so what? It's not like we don't have experts here. We also have experts who can fight against them."
This is the same situation now, and this side is not completely incapable of dealing with it.
Jia Huan nodded when he heard this. After all, his skills were good and he could deal with some people. In addition, there might be some people on the other side that he could deal with well.
"I know this, and I believe that in the next situation, we will be able to completely grasp him."
"You don't need to worry too much. If we do the things we are doing right now, he won't have any major problems."
Now they still have such a preparation. Now that they have such a preparation, it will be much easier to do other things.
It would be much easier if they had done it here first, so they rushed there immediately after organizing their people.
There is absolutely no hesitation at all. For such guys, they should be dealt with as soon as possible.
Jia Huan will not be merciful to anyone, no matter how good that person's reputation is, because in his opinion, the world has become such a mess, so what does it matter no matter how good the reputation is? Probably not much better.
So when faced with such a guy, it should be dealt with as soon as possible. It should never be kept and it would be a waste.
So after receiving this mission from the emperor, he quickly began to organize the people on his side, completely ignoring these guys.
After all, you have to solve it as soon as possible, so that you can handle these things well. If you stay here for too long, then the rest of the time will be wasted and will not be of much use.
Jia Huan and Ye Tianshi set off immediately with their confidants to perform tasks locally.
